issues.description: The problem specification requires implementing check_status to return a Boolean value (0 or 1) in EAX. The solution implementation of check_status (mov eax, hello) places the address of the 'hello' data label into EAX (a pointer), not a Boolean 0/1 value. This contradicts the stated requirement and would cause automated validation or student expectations to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the implementation of check_status to place a Boolean value (0 or 1) in EAX before returning. For example, set eax to 0 or 1 depending on the intended status (e.g., xor eax, eax / inc eax to return 1, or xor eax, eax to return 0) so the function conforms to the problem specification.
